summary: First test run of CourtSplit. Backend: 10/10 pytest passed (CRUD, calc worked-example ₱160.00 = ₱100 court + ₱60 shuttle, rounding case 100/3=33.33, 404s, paid toggle persistence). Frontend: full flow validated on mobile viewport - Home navigation, New Session live calc (per=₱160.00, total=₱960.00, court=₱100.00, shuttle=₱60.00), Session Detail toggle+collected/outstanding update, direct full-page load of /summary/:id and /sessions/:id both load data correctly with correct player rows/footer, Edit prefill works, Delete works, 404 summary handled.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend uses @app.on_event('shutdown') which is deprecated in FastAPI — switch to lifespan handler.
SessionForm addPlayer doesn't assign uuid to new players client-side; backend correctly generates. OK but note ids for keys use array index which can misbehave on reorder.
Summary page shows same courtPortion/shuttlePortion per player row (fine given equal-shares spec).
No input validation for negative court_fee / num_shuttles on backend — Pydantic allows negatives; consider adding ge=0 constraints.
seed_data_creation: Test data created with TEST_ prefix was cleaned up (deleted) during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py cover CRUD, calc, 404s, toggle. All passed. Frontend direct-navigation to /summary/:id and /sessions/:id both hydrate correctly. Data-testids present on all critical elements. If retesting, use wait_for_function on input value equal to expected for Edit page prefill (getSession is async).
